subject: EdgeScale renewal: usage, latency trade-offs and upgrade path
thread_body:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgescale.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeScale Billing <billing@edgescale.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal touch + Q1 usage + latency notes

Hi Mina,

We're starting renewal planning on our side for the Aug 1 contract renewal and wanted to get a refresh from you on consumption trends + recommendations. Q1 token spend is up ~42% quarter-over-quarter as we roll out the new answer-aggregation feature. The feature has improved user retention (up ~6 pp), so ROI is material, but we've seen periodic latency spikes around peak traffic windows (see attached latency_snapshot_May03.png).

Attached: EdgeScale_Q1_usage.csv, latency_snapshot_May03.png

Two asks from my side:
- Can Redwood help recommend a capacity path (commit bump / dedicated vs. reserved) that keeps 95th p99 latency below 350ms?
- Can we quantify expected unit-cost impact if we move 20–30% of traffic to a quantized variant + prefetch?

Also cc'ing billing to understand invoice lead times if we accelerate a commit.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Product Manager, EdgeScale

-----
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgescale.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, EdgeScale Billing <billing@edgescale.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal touch + Q1 usage + latency notes

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the attachments, useful context. Quick responses and next steps: 

1) I can run a short readout with our CS and infra teams to map out two paths: (A) modest commit increase + batching/cache tuning, (B) dedicated pool pilot with a traffic split.
2) Grace will put together a short cost/latency ROI with concrete token/unit projections for the 20–30% quantized split you mentioned.

Proposed times for a 30-minute readout: Wed 5/5 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 5/6 9:00–9:30 PT. Are either of those workable?

I'll also prepare a baseline SOW for the Dedicated pilot and a price sketch for commit tiers so Billing can see timelines.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgescale.ai>, EdgeScale Billing <billing@edgescale.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: EdgeScale quick analysis (pre-read)

Mina / Karthik — attaching a quick analysis workbook (minas_analysis.xlsx) with three tabs: usage profile, latency by 15-min bucket, and cost delta for quantized vs FP16 variants. TL;DR summary below: 

- Current run-rate looks like ~1.9B tokens/month (Q1 avg), peak concurrency windows at 11:30–12:30 PT and 18:00–19:00 PT.
- p95 baseline (hosted API) = ~210ms, p99 spikes to ~520ms during 11:30 window (burst pattern).
- Prefetch + KV prefix caching reduces p99 by ~60–80ms in synthetic replay; quantization (8-bit) reduces unit cost by ~22% on our model mix with small quality delta in your eval prompts.

Recommendation (sequence):
1) Short-term: enable aggressive KV caching + two-hour pre-warm around your morning peak — should drop p99 to ~420ms immediately.
2) Mid-term: 20% traffic on quantized variant + commit increase of 15% — expected blended unit-cost savings ~12% with p99 ~360ms.
3) If you need p99 < 350ms consistently, propose a Dedicated pilot for a single shard with autoscale headroom during peak (we can run a 4-week pilot to measure).

Action items:
- Mina: confirm meeting time.
- Karthik: prepare 3 pricing options (commit tiers + Dedicated pilot price) and a DocuSign link for quick acceptance.

Grace
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgescale.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeScale Billing <billing@edgescale.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal touch + Q1 usage + latency notes

Hi Liam — thanks for the context and to Grace for the prep. I pulled three concise options for you; full line items available in the attached HubSpot quote (link below). Short version: 

Option A — Commit bump (no Dedicated)
- +15% committed tokens for 12 months
- Estimated monthly cost delta: +$14.5k
- Expected blended unit-cost change after 20% quantized traffic: -8%

Option B — 4-week Dedicated pilot
- Dedicated single-shard pilot (GPU-backed), includes 24/7 support and SLA for p99 target 350ms during pilot windows
- Pilot price: $28k flat for 4 weeks + pro-rated consumed tokens
- If pilot converts to full Dedicated, credit pilot toward first month.

Option C — Commit + Dedicated hybrid (recommended for predictable latency)
- +10% commit + 8-week Dedicated pilot priced at $45k with conversion credit
- Target blended p99 < 350ms with KV caching and prefetch

DocuSign/accept link: https://docusign.example.com/edgescale/ES-2027-042/quote
HubSpot quote: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ES-2027-042/quote

If you're happy, I can send a concise SOW and a billing invoice; Mina will coordinate approvals.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgescale.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeScale Billing <billing@edgescale.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal touch + Q1 usage + latency notes

Team — appreciate the quick analysis. We're inclined to go with Option C (Commit + Dedicated hybrid).Two notes:

1) Can you issue a short SOW that reflects +10% commit and an 8-week pilot priced at $45k with conversion credit? We'll route to legal/finance right away.
2) Billing: we need invoice timing (+net terms) and a clear statement of credits if we convert pilot to full Dedicated.

Attaching: signed-SOW-v2.pdf (placeholder—we'll sign once the SOW matches the pilot credit language).

Would like to kick the pilot the week of May 17 if Redwood can commit the shard. Let us know immediate next steps and any pre-onboarding info we should send.

Thanks,
Liam
Product Manager, EdgeScale
